llm_prompts.name: a6_review
llm_prompts.prompt_template: You will receive the notebook content in content.preview. Review the submission for: (1) completeness, (2) correctness signals, (3) code quality (readability, organization), and (4) clarity of explanations. Give 3-6 specific actionable suggestions. If content.preview is missing or too short, say you cannot assess content.
